mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 3% annualized signals stronger household demand, which boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or IC drops below 0.05 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals a tightening labor market, which raises wage pressure and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or IC falls below 0.04 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below 0.5% annualized signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or IC drops below 0.04 over any 2-year window.

failure_condition: If 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or IC falls below 0.04 over any 2-year window.
